description: Creates a channel in an Amazon Chime SDK Messaging AppInstance. Members of a channel exchange messages within it. Every channel operation is performed on behalf of an AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot, whose ARN is supplied as ChimeBearer and forms part of the channel's CloudFormation identifier.

ChimeBearer.description: The AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot ARN to enumerate as. ListChannels returns the channels this bearer is authorised to see: an AppInstanceAdmin enumerates every channel in the AppInstance, while a plain bearer enumerates public channels and its own memberships but not a private channel it created itself. Use an AppInstanceAdmin bearer for complete enumeration. Every returned identifier pairs a channel with this bearer and resolves through READ, because READ asks the service the same authorisation question this listing did.
